query_text: 想找一家菜品美味新鲜、做得很地道的餐厅，有推荐的吗？
requirement_text: 评论需直接说明菜品美味、新鲜、烹制得好。
evidence_span: The food was delicious and fresh.
evidence_context: The food was delicious and fresh. I love the vibes and the set up. Service was a little slow, they needed more staff, but other than that great service and great experience.

query_text: 请大家推荐一家菜的味道好、火候掌握得恰到好处的餐厅。
requirement_text: 评论需直接说明菜品入味、口感好、火候恰当。
evidence_span: Everything was full of flavor and cooked perfectly.
evidence_context: We had quesadillas, humus which I have never had before, chicken skewers, brussel sprouts, pork sliders, and something I can't remember.  Everything was full of flavor and cooked perfectly. We really enjoyed it here.

query_text: 哪种餐厅的菜品真正好吃、烹制用心？求推荐。
requirement_text: 评论需直接证明菜品难吃、夹生过老或质量差。
evidence_span: The potatoes were undercooked on the inside and overcooked on the outside, also flavorless.
evidence_context: Food was terrible. Everything was dried out and overcooked. I ordered the eggs over medium and they were over easy. The toast was stale. The bacon was so dried out that I felt like I was eating poor quality jerky. The potatoes were undercooked on the inside and overcooked on the outside, also flavorless. It was a really overpriced, poor quality, and flavorless food.

query_text: 想去一家菜做得好吃、够入味的餐厅吃饭，哪里合适？
requirement_text: 评论需直接证明菜品乏味、调味不足、没有味道。
evidence_span: The food was bland and poorly seasoned. We ate a variety of dishes and without exception they were tasteless.
evidence_context: While we were excited to taste the food at this well reviewed restaurant, aside from the very fine servers, we were completely underwhelmed. The food was bland and poorly seasoned. We ate a variety of dishes and without exception they were tasteless.
